en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3322 - Al-Ala narrated from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Ja'far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as), regarding a man who observes the accounting between two men and is then called to testify.
Imam (as) said: "If he wishes, he may testify, and if he wishes, he may abstain from testifying."
